## V. The revocation and the 2020 notice

Q29. I show you Exhibit "F". What is it?

A29. It is the Special Power of Attorney my sisters and I signed on August 15, 2005 before Vice Consul Noemi T. Diaz at the Philippine Consulate General in Los Angeles. By it we appointed a new attorney-in-fact and disowned any power of attorney in favor of anyone else. [Exh. F; keep to the face of the document]

Q30. Whose signature appears over your name, and where did you sign?

A30. Mine. I signed it at the Philippine Consulate General in Los Angeles. [CONFIRM]

Q31. What was Mr. de la Fuente told of Exhibit "F", by whom, and when, if you know of your own knowledge?

A31. I did not tell him myself, and I do not know first-hand who told him or when. [CONFIRM] [her 2023 affidavits say he was "well aware"; if she has a first-hand basis, she states it instead; she must not guess]

Q32. I show you Exhibit "G", the Notice to the Public published in the Bicol Post on September 25, October 2 and October 9, 2020. Did you authorize that notice?

A32. Yes, through our lawyers. [CONFIRM]

Q33. Why was it published?

A33. To inform the public that the power of attorney we had given Mr. de la Fuente was revoked on August 15, 2005, and that any transaction he entered into after that date was unauthorized and void. [Exh. G, the notice's own words]

Q34. I show you a letter dated August 15, 2019 signed by Atty. Ma. Carmen Agcaoili-Orena, for marking as Exhibit "O-2". What is it, and was it sent on your behalf?

A34. It is a letter dated August 15, 2019 from our lawyer, Atty. Ma. Carmen Agcaoili-Orena. It was sent on behalf of my sisters and me. [CONFIRM]
